statement: The home-lab CLI (scripts/lab/*) meets the repository's script guidelines: every scalar, state and name has a named constant owner (R06) and each outcome is decided at one boundary, so audit:guidelines - and the post-push static audits it belongs to - are green on main again. The CLI's command surface, its remote scripts and its inventory format are unchanged: this is a naming repair, not a behaviour change, and the witnesses prove both halves.

constraints.statement: The guideline baselines are not extended for scripts/lab; the literals get owners (one-way ratchet rule).
Every command, flag, remote shell/PowerShell script, label derivation and inventory path is byte-for-byte what it was; only where a value lives changes.
The only new file under scripts/ is the quest's evidence harness in scripts/quest-evidence/, the sanctioned home for receipts (epic rule 2026-09-13).
